data.name: Elizondo Electric
data.address: 855 n master, 8118 Melinda Ln, Dallas, TX 75217

reviews.text: Contact Martin to get a bid on having LED lights installed on top and bottom of our cabinets as the kitchen area was too dark due to the canister lamps. Installation was smooth and had a dimmer switch added to give it a nice touch and allowing us to control the brightness if needed.

I was required to get an electrical inspection of my home in South Oak Cliff for a City of Dallas Permit.  Elizondo knew how the pull the permit and got it the same day!  He then had the inspection scheduled for the next day!  He checked out my house and sent pictures to the inspector and got my green tag on the second day.  I have been a landlord for 40 years and have never seen an electrician who is this good!  He knows the inspectors and how to navigate the Dallas permitting system through Da

I had an excellent experience with with this electrician! When my dishwasher caused a power outage, the technician arrived promptly and diagnosed the issue quickly. They fixed the wiring problem efficiently, restoring power in no time. What stood out was their patience in explaining how to properly use my breaker panel, empowering me to handle minor issues in the future. The pricing was fair, and the service was professional yet friendly. They even followed up to ensure everything was working pe
Great service and price!  I called them about a switch that wasn't working properly.  They came the same day, did a great job, resolved several problems.  Very competent and friendly!

If you you are tired of messed up quality work,  call Martin.   I have the highest regards for his work,  not because he's a friend whom I've known for years, but the expertise is a one of a kind of experience that I invite you to join, and enjoy a job well done.   Thanks my friend for treating me and everyone you encounter like family.

Bob

Excellent service I called on a Saturday thinking no one would answer but I was wrong, Martin answered his phone and was at my house with in 30-45 minutes. He came assess the problem spent about 3-hours doing repairs when he handed me the bill I was amazed at how reasonable he was . After he had been gone for while I plugged in a recliner and the lights blinked , I called him back and he came back Sunday morning, Who does that?  He found a bad outlet replaced it when I tried to pay him he said N

Elizondo came by the same day we contacted him and took care of our electrical need. He followed up with us confirming that he was on his way and gave a time frame in which we could expect his arrival. We are super pleased with his service. Also, the price was reasonable.

We had an emergency  issue  with the circuit  breaker making noise.  I called on a Saturday afternoon. The electrician was at my mother's house within 15-20 minutes. He was professional and polite . He cleaned  and switched out the damaged circuits within  an hour. My mother and I were very pleased.

Martin was on time he did a great job and he communicated very well. He did the job in a timely manner and made sure my lights was back on fast. I recommend him to anyone who needs there electric back on or wired. He was just all around great so call him.

I highly recommend Elizondo Electric! I’m very pleased with the quality and service of work. If you are looking for a company that is ethical, then your search is over! Martin showed a passion for his job, which translated to pure excellence and professionalism. He was well organized and asked questions for clarification. Well done, sir! I will most definitely be contacting him again in the future if need be. Five stars from me and my family!

Martin was very thorough, polite and professional. He checked my main electrical box and told me what was needed. He repaired some electrical outlets and bathroom light fixture. He arrived at the time he gave me. No waiting. I will most definitely refer and use Elizondo Electric again.

We found Elizondo Electric on Craigslist and called for an estimate. Martin was incredibly helpful and thorough over the phone, and very responsive to subsequent emails and texts. We were scheduled within 2 weeks of the initial phone call, with an estimate of 2 days to complete the work. Martin showed up on time and completed the work in one day. We were impressed with his professionalism and quality of work, as well as the speed with which the work was completed. We will definitely schedule wit

Had complete electric upgrade in older house,  If you want a good price, with quality work, using quality parts, THIS IS YOUR GUY!  I will not use anyone ese.  Have had several people bid on work, by far this guy was the most knowledgeable,  and only uses good parts.  I am so glad I picked him.  I give him A+++

I have to start off saying how professional he was and on time. He explained what the problem was in detail. He checked everything and recommended some updates going forward. He was courteous and polite. Please reach if you're in need of some electrical work.

I used the website to request a quote, then called and was able to have an electrician out the next day. Completed the job quickly, educated me on the repair and saved my lots of money. Thank you so much!!!

Was recommended by a friend, so we met up to speak about our kitchen remodel, great customer service, on time, fast timely manner, they stated a time of how long it would take and they kept to it, I highly recommend to anyone that needs any help done.
He is a good man and has really good results.Prices are good for the results and overall go with this man.He is a good worker and amazing results.
Friendly, prompt, knowledgeable-  thank you.
Great worker.Great Price range.Really good work from him,Worth The 5 Stars and the price.
Very responsive. Offered a great rate and did excellent work. Highly recommend for any work.

I paid him $500 to tag himself to my permit that I pulled myself and paid for at the City of Dallas. He tagged himself to my permit, took my money, and then 3 days later withdrew himself. Now I have to find another master licensed electrican for the final inspection. These master license contractors make a side business taking advantage of homeowners who pull their own permits and charge crazy rates just to tag themselves to permits I already paid for. an extremely professional electrician. did his job right and quick. he did an excellent job for a low price.
Great professional service. Clear communication and ready to work.
Elizondo had our office back up and running within minutes. Definitely recommend him.
